from typing import Any

import random
from datetime import date, timedelta


class Execution:
    name: str = "generate_sales_data"
    description: str = "Generates 20 sample sales orders plus 3 intentionally invalid records."
    category: str = "data"

    inputs: list[dict] = []

    outputs: list[dict] = [
        {"name": "records", "type": list},
    ]

    parameters: dict = {
        "seed": {"type": float, "default": 42},
    }

    def run(self, inputs, parameters, context):
        rng = random.Random(int(parameters.get("seed", 42)))
        customers = ["CUST-%03d" % i for i in range(1, 13)]
        catalogue = [
            ("Laptop Pro 15", 1499.00),
            ("Wireless Mouse", 39.50),
            ("Mechanical Keyboard", 129.00),
            ("4K Monitor", 429.00),
            ("USB-C Hub", 79.00),
            ("Noise-Cancel Headphones", 289.00),
            ("Office Chair", 349.00),
            ("Webcam HD", 99.00),
        ]
        regions = ["North", "South", "East", "West"]
        start = date(2026, 1, 5)

        records: list[dict] = []
        for index in range(1, 21):
            product, unit_price = catalogue[rng.randrange(len(catalogue))]
            records.append(
                {
                    "order_id": "ORD-%04d" % (1000 + index),
                    "customer_id": customers[rng.randrange(len(customers))],
                    "product": product,
                    "quantity": rng.randint(1, 6),
                    "unit_price": unit_price,
                    "order_date": (start + timedelta(days=rng.randint(0, 80))).isoformat(),
                    "region": regions[rng.randrange(len(regions))],
                }
            )

        # Intentionally invalid records for the validation stage.
        records.append(
            {
                "order_id": "ORD-9001",
                "customer_id": "",
                "product": "4K Monitor",
                "quantity": 2,
                "unit_price": 429.00,
                "order_date": "2026-02-10",
                "region": "North",
            }
        )
        records.append(
            {
                "order_id": "ORD-9002",
                "customer_id": "CUST-004",
                "product": "USB-C Hub",
                "quantity": 0,
                "unit_price": 79.00,
                "order_date": "2026-02-12",
                "region": "West",
            }
        )
        records.append(
            {
                "order_id": "ORD-9003",
                "customer_id": "CUST-007",
                "product": "Office Chair",
                "quantity": 3,
                "unit_price": -349.00,
                "order_date": "2026-13-45",
                "region": "Atlantis",
            }
        )

        return {"records": records}

    def build_output(self, inputs, parameters, context):
        return self.run(inputs, parameters, context)
